info.name: Sentimently API v1
info.description:
Generated from openapi/openapi.v1.json.

1. Run POST /auth/login (or register). The token is saved for you.
2. Set productId (GET /products).
3. POST /quote, then POST /checkout. The order id and number are saved for the other requests.

Staff and admin requests need a token from a staff or admin account.
